mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.1% indicates an ultra-loose monetary policy that compresses discount rates for equity valuation, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as the economy absorbs accommodative financing.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS is below 0.1%.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 0.15% signals aggressive monetary tightening that increases real discount rates for equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as market risk premiums expand.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS exceeds 0.15%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous payroll growth exceeding 0.5% and unemployment rate falling below 5.0% indicates a robust labor market that accelerates consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when PAYEMS growth > 0.5% and UNRATE < 5.0%.

mechanism_narrative: GDP growth exceeding 2.0% annualized and housing starts above 950,000 units define a late-cycle expansion where economic momentum peaks, increasing equity valuation risks and producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when GDPC1 growth > 2.0% and HOUST > 950.

mechanism_narrative: Manufacturing production index above 100.0 indicates sustained industrial output growth that supports corporate revenue stability, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as supply chain resilience strengthens earnings outlooks.
failure_condition: S&P 500 60-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when INDPRO exceeds 100.0.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts above 950,000 units signal robust construction activity and consumer confidence, accelerating economic growth and corporate earnings momentum, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 5-day returns are negative in more than 40% of instances when HOUST exceeds 950.

mechanism_narrative: Unemployment rate exceeding 6.0% indicates economic distress that depresses consumer spending and corporate earnings expectations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days as recession risks rise.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 6.0%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous federal funds rate below 0.1% and CPI inflation exceeding 3.0% year-over-year indicates a high-inflation, low-rate environment that increases real interest rate uncertainty and equity risk, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: S&P 500 20-day returns are positive in more than 40% of instances when FEDFUNDS < 0.1% and CPIAUCSL YoY > 3.0%.
